name: Babies Going To Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that little children hold a special place in God's kingdom, as Jesus emphasizes the necessity of becoming like children to enter heaven (Matthew 18:3) and welcomes them, declaring that the kingdom of heaven belongs to such (Matthew 19:14). The innocence of children, who have not yet discerned good and evil, is recognized by God, who promises them a place in His inheritance (Deuteronomy 1:39). Furthermore, Jesus warns against despising these little ones, affirming that their angels continually behold the Father's face in heaven (Matthew 18:10). From before birth, God knows and sets apart each child for His purposes (Jeremiah 1:5), underscoring the divine care and sanctity surrounding their souls.
